pkgmetadata.longdescription: Crush is a terminal-native AI coding agent from Charm. It speaks to multiple LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Bedrock, Vertex AI, local Ollama/OpenAI-compatible endpoints), keeps per-project session state, integrates with editors via LSP, and exposes MCP servers for extensibility. Written in Go with a Bubble Tea TUI.
